entries.claim: The Atlanta Falcons' 2026 schedule includes primetime matchups and divisional games early in the season.
The Falcons will open the 2026 season on the road against the Steelers.
The Steelers game will feature new coaches for both teams: Mike McCarthy for the Steelers and Kevin Stefanski for the Falcons.
In a previous game against the Steelers, the Falcons spent money on Kirk Cousins while the Steelers did not spend on Russell Wilson, and the cheaper quarterback (Wilson) won.
There is a question about whether Tua Tagovailoa will start at quarterback for the Falcons in 2026.
The game plan from Zac Robinson against the Steelers in a past game was not good, specifically regarding how they handled T.J. Watt and the lack of play action.
Tommy Reese will be tested in the Week 1 Steelers game to see if he can develop a better game plan, especially since he has seen the Steelers multiple times.
Aaron Rodgers' future playing status is uncertain and affects the perception of the Week 1 Falcons game.
The Falcons' defense was better in 2024, but the offense struggled to score enough points to win games.
The Falcons face Bryce Young and the Panthers in Week 2 at home, which is an opportunity to break a streak of losses against him.
Putting pressure on Bryce Young is a key strategy, as he tends to fold when pressured.
Rushing four players and having Jessie Bates play around in coverage is suggested as a game plan against Bryce Young.
The Falcons have three consecutive primetime games in weeks 3-5: at the Packers (Thursday), at the Saints (Monday), and vs. Ravens (Sunday).
Raheem Morris's Falcons teams played well in primetime, going 7-3 during his two-year stint.
Kevin Stefanski has a winning record in primetime games from his time as head coach of the Browns.
The three-game primetime stretch is seen as a measuring stick for the Falcons against playoff-caliber teams like the Packers, Ravens, and Saints.
The Thursday night game provides a mini bye week, which can help teams with injuries.
There is a question about whether Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Falcons in 2026, potentially debuting in Week 5 against the Ravens.
Kevin Stefanski's handling of quarterback situations in Cleveland was 'weird,' and there's hope it won't be repeated with the Falcons.
The Browns have had a high number of starting quarterbacks since their return to Cleveland.
The Ravens game in Week 5 starts a tough stretch of the Falcons' season.
The Falcons' schedule includes a trip to Madrid, Spain, to play the Bengals in Week 9, followed by a home game against the Chiefs in Week 10, with the bye week occurring after the Chiefs game.
The scheduling of the bye week after the overseas trip to Madrid is questioned as illogical.
There is interest in seeing how Caleb Williams is playing by Week 9, as he had an up-and-down rookie season with some great moments in the playoffs.
Raheem Morris will be returning to Atlanta as the defensive coordinator for the San Francisco 49ers, and he will likely be booed.
One speaker believes the Chiefs game might be the easiest of the five tough opponents leading into the bye week, as they are not convinced the Chiefs are still the same dominant team.
The other speaker strongly disagrees with the assessment of the Chiefs, citing Patrick Mahomes as a factor and warning about the danger if he has time to throw.
There is a debate about whether Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Falcons by Week 12 after the bye week, or if Tua Tagovailoa will still be the starter.
If the Falcons have a 5-5 or 4-6 record by Week 12, Michael Penix Jr. should play to get an evaluation.
If the Falcons are 8-2 by Week 12, they should stick with Tua Tagovailoa.

The Atlanta Falcons have potential due to a new coaching staff with Kevin Stefanski as head coach.
The Falcons roster features playmakers like running back Bijan Robinson, wide receiver Drake London, and tight end Kyle Pitts.
The Falcons' offensive line is considered competent.
The defense was ranked 14th in EPA per drive in the previous season.
The quarterback situation is described as 'terrible'.

Tua Tagovailoa, signed in free agency, is the presumptive Week 1 starter due to Penix's health status.
